Container.Name: minecraft-server-manager
Container.Overview: Search Modrinth and CurseForge for Minecraft modpacks and run each one as its own server container.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets the app create and manage Minecraft server containers.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings and state for the manager.

Config.Name: Server data host path
Config.Description: Host folder holding each Minecraft server's files (worlds, mods, configs). Must be the host side of the App data path plus /servers. Leave as is unless you changed App data.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where world backups are saved, one folder per server. Point this at a user share (for example /mnt/user/backups/minecraft) to keep backups off the cache drive.

Config.Name: CurseForge API key
Config.Description: Optional. Needed for CurseForge search; get one at console.curseforge.com.
